command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

echo "== verify staged inputs against their pinned sha256 =="
printf "%s  %s\n" 61eba5b05ef7d9ae5310e756c1143fa48072de3856d36871bb14e57aa2435ff3 chr20.fa > pins.sha256
printf "%s  %s\n" 4bd24cdfa4486964f070e69b5dd109b6e1e78561783d48c4e62cc6fae3536a00 HG00096_chr20smoke_1.fq.gz >> pins.sha256
printf "%s  %s\n" ebd1ad56bc572a4bf157ba21d1ad8ef074ea25f02eb2d982d9f0089180d82a04 HG00096_chr20smoke_2.fq.gz >> pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256

echo "== bwa index (same reference bytes the bwa-samtools recipe uses) =="
bwa index -p bwaidx chr20.fa

echo "== bwa mem -t 8 (baseline alignment; identical flags to the bwa-mem2 leg) =="
bwa mem -t 8 -R "@RG\tID:smoke\tSM:HG00096\tPL:ILLUMINA\tLB:SRR062634" bwaidx HG00096_chr20smoke_1.fq.gz HG00096_chr20smoke_2.fq.gz > aln_bwa.sam

echo "== baseline record count =="
grep -c '^[^@]' aln_bwa.sam > bwa_records.txt
cat bwa_records.txt
